## Highlights
- **Windows tested end to end** — CLI, workbench, MCP and CUDA on Windows 11. Fixes below make it work out of the box.

## Fixes
- Find the model in a cache set with the older `HUGGINGFACE_HUB_CACHE` variable (#7)
- doctor: warn when an NVIDIA GPU is present but PyTorch is CPU-only (#7)
- Workbench: the folder picker lists Windows drives (#7)
- Tests no longer need symlink rights on Windows (#7)

## Docs
- Windows + NVIDIA: install `torch` and `torchvision` together from the CUDA index (#7)
- PowerShell-friendly `claude mcp add` / `codex mcp add` (#7)
- README in 简体中文 and 日本語 (#5); banner and badges (#4)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kanaworksai-hue/sonicproof/compare/v0.1.1...v0.1.2
